question: LLM decode latency memory bandwidth bound formula

sources.title: [2605.30571] Memory-Bound but Not Bandwidth-Limited: The Physical AI ...
sources.snippet: Physical-AI decode is memory-dominated, but faster memory does not translate into proportional latency gains. We test the missing term with a CUDA Graphs A/B experiment. On H100 at ctx=2048, CUDA Graphs improves decode latency by 1.259x across N=10 fresh sessions, with a 95 percent bootstrap confidence interval of 1.253 to 1.267.
